## Result

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Knowledge and verification

For engine-dependent code, crash analysis or map checks: state the matching build/architecture, knowledge revision and relevant finding/rule IDs, what evidence was consulted, coverage gaps and verification level. Keep raw evidence and private paths local. If unrelated to game behavior, state why knowledge use is not applicable.

List focused tests/observations and material limits. Distinguish static/synthetic results from runtime load, gameplay and save/reopen evidence.

## Publication

Confirm the candidate files contain only reviewed original tools/tests/docs/analysis; no raw game corpus, assets, snapshots or diagnostics. No merge/release follows from this template.
